description:
Beka ukuphepha komndeni wakho endaweni yokuqala neFamio.

Yakhelwe ukuthula kwengqondo, i-Famio ikusiza ukuthi uhlale uxhumekile ngedijithali nabantu obathandayo, noma ngabe bakuphi.

Gcina umndeni wakho useduze futhi uvikelekile, noma ngabe ukude kangakanani. I-Famio isiza wena nokuhlala kwakho okuthandayo nokuthandayo kakhulu ukuxhumana futhi, okubaluleke kakhulu, kuphephile.

Thola amandla wezinto ze-Famio kutholakale kalula:
- Xhuma ngokushesha abathandekayo nomndeni.
- Yabela amaqembu futhi uhlale useduze kukamama wakho, ubaba, abafowenu, odadewenu, njll.
- Yaziswa uma ibhethri lefoni liphansi ukuze wazi ukuthi kungani bengaphenduli ifoni yabo.
- Thola amafoni uma elahlekile noma ebiwe.

Uyazi ukuthi umndeni wakho ukuphi manje? Cha? Isikhathi sokukhulisa ukuphepha komndeni wakho neFamio.
Landa i-Famio manje futhi ube-ukwazi i-24/7!
Qaphela. Lolu hlelo lokusebenza aluhloselwe ukufakwa ngasese; sicela uthole imvume ngaphambi kokusebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza.

Ufuna ukwenza iFamio ibe ngcono kakhulu?
Xhumana nathi ku-info@harmonybit.com ukuze wabelane ngeziphakamiso zakho.
summary: I-Famio ikuvumela ukuthi uhlale uthintana nomndeni wakho nabathandekayo! Zigcine ziphephile!
title: Famio: Connect With Family
